initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Schools and educational activities' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

scenario_definition.one_shot_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
clarifications.Ce: I have no requirement on the energy class.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: The request explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Schools and educational activities' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
